childOutputNeverDrained.text: {{stream}} of this child is never read before its {{event}} is awaited, so output past the pipe buffer blocks the child and {{event}} never fires. Read it (`child.{{stream}}.on('data', ...)`, or pipe it), or pass `'ignore'` or `'inherit'` in stdio.

pipeUnreadAtWait.text: The {{stream}} pipe is not read before `{{wait}}` on some path here, so output past the 64 KB pipe buffer blocks the child and `{{wait}}` never returns. Read it to its end first (`io.ReadAll`, or a goroutine copying it, started before the wait), or give the command a buffer or `os.Stdout` instead of a pipe.
